speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You were on the boards before the house was up. I have a dish in my hands. Eat while it is still a breakfast.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will eat. I was writing.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I heard you walking. Was it the lovers again?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: No is a short answer, and I will take it. The loaf is still a thumb short of the notch, and it is still a penny. Sit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am sitting. There is nothing for the stair this morning.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the stair will survive without it. Mark me, I asked, and you have said no, and I am not asking a second time before noon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Before noon I am eating. That is the whole of the news.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. The dish is down. Do not burn a candle over a breakfast I have already carried up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. The board can wait until I am out of the house.
